subject: Request: Trial boost for private VPC POC — security gating follow-up
messages:
From: Amit Patel <amit@cureplus.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Rao <p.rao@cureplus.ai>
Date: 2025-05-29T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Private VPC POC — question on trial capacity and security gating

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We were impressed with the latency numbers for private VPC mode. Before we spin up a full pilot we need to validate two things on your side:

- A short-term increase in trial capacity (we're asking for a 6-week booster to cover peak ingest for an initial data migration).
- Confirmation that we can get redacted SOC2 evidence and a simple network diagram for our security review to sign off on a scoped pilot.

Our security team (copied) also asked whether you can place an agreed list of audit fields into an evidence escrow (or provide a secure share link) so they can run their checklist without getting raw data access. If you can outline what you need from us and any gating conditions, we can move quickly.

Appreciate it — aim is to start the POC in early June if we can get the approvals.

Best,
Amit

--

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: 2025-05-29T16:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC POC — question on trial capacity and security gating

Hi Amit — thanks for the clear list. Short answer: we can do a time-limited trial booster and provide the docs you need with a couple of conditions. Outline below and then I can loop in our security lead if needed.

Proposal:
- Trial booster: 6 weeks of increased reserved capacity scoped to your pilot cluster (temporary quota increase on Dedicated/Private).
- Evidence: redacted SOC2 summary + network/topology diagram (we can provide a sanitized PDF and PNG).
- Escrow/access: we can provide a secure read-only share (S3 presigned + audit logs) to your security team for the checklist; raw customer data will remain isolated.

To proceed we'll need:
1) A short mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones and dates.
2) Confirmation that the pilot will not ingest PHI (per your note during the call) — if PHI is present, we will need an additional compliance review and may limit the booster.
3) Signed standard POC MOU (I can push a template) — this documents the timebox and evidence scope.

If that sounds right I'll request approval from finance/security for the booster and share the sanitized SOC2 doc. Available for a 30-min sync tomorrow if you want to run the checklist live.

—Marissa

Subject: Internal: Approval ask — 6-week trial booster for CurePlus (DL-4772)

Karthik / Priyom,

Customer: CurePlus AI (Amit + Priya). They want a 6-week temporary boost on a Private/VPC pilot to cover a migration window. Security needs redacted SOC2 and a sanitized network diagram; they want a scoped read-only evidence share for their review.

Ask: can we approve a 6-week booster (non-recurring) scoped to a single pilot cluster for DL-4772? Conditions I propose:
- Booster limited to the pilot project id and disabled automatically after 6 weeks.
- Customer signs our POC MOU (I will send).
- Provide redacted SOC2 summary (attachment) and sanitized network diagram (attachment).
- If PHI is discovered, escalate and pause booster until compliance confirms.

Attachments included in the draft reply: SOC2_cert_redacted.pdf, vpc_network_diagram.png.

Notes: finance impact is small (we'll treat as marketing/eng trial budget). We should track usage against the MAP so we can avoid overprovisioning.

Can you confirm approval or flag any concerns?

Thanks,
Marissa

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: 2025-06-02T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC POC — question on trial capacity and security gating

Hi Amit / Priya — following up with the plan and confirmation.

Good news: finance and security approved a one-time 6-week trial booster for CurePlus AI, scoped as discussed. Conditions below:

1) Scope & duration: 6 weeks starting on the date the pilot cluster is created (we'll toggle the quota on the pilot project id).
2) Deliverables from Redwood: sanitized SOC2 summary (attached), a sanitized VPC topology diagram (attached), and a secure read-only S3 share we will enable for your security review. Access will be logged and expires with the booster.
3) Customer requirements: sign the POC MOU (Doc link below), confirm no PHI in pilot datasets, and provide the MAP milestones (ingest start / migration window).
4) Escrow: we will not place raw logs into an external escrow; instead we provide auditable access to the artifacts above. If you still require escrow, we can discuss a scoped solution with legal.

Attachments: SOC2_cert_redacted.pdf (sanitized), vpc_network_diagram.png (sanitized).

Next steps:
- Please review and sign the POC MOU here: https://redwood.example.com/poctemplate/DL-4772
- Send your preferred pilot start date and MAP milestones.
- I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with Karthik (solutions) and Priyom (security ops) to walk through the access flow.

If you want the kickoff this week, I have windows Wed 10–11am PT or Thu 2–3pm PT.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—Marissa
